Setup & Seamless In-Place Upgrade Scripts (v2.0 • v1.1 Retro • v1.0 Archive)

Inspect how RaggieSoft StoreTrainer packages both its vintage Windows 95–compatible setup and in-place patcher (v1.1) and its modern StoreTrainer 2.0 setup wizard — including automatic in-place migration from classic v1.0 and v1.1 installations that keeps your saved My StoreFiles library and shared classic system files safe.

RaggieSoftWizardCommon.iss (Express vs. Custom Setup Mode & Shared Update Packaging)

Shared setup customization module offering Express vs. Custom installation modes, RaggieSoftUpdate.exe bundling, and multi-user association cleanup.

; ================================================================================
; FILE: RaggieSoftWizardCommon.iss
; LOCATION: SharedInno\RaggieSoftWizardCommon.iss
; INCLUDED BY: StoreTrainer.iss, BookReader.iss, ListeningRoom.iss,
;              Backstage.iss, and RaggieSoftLauncher.iss
; LICENSE: MIT License (Code)
;
; PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
;   What is this shared '.iss' include file?
;     Instead of copy-pasting the same setup customization logic into five separate
;     Inno Setup scripts, every RaggieSoft '.iss' script pulls this file in with:
;       #include "..\SharedInno\RaggieSoftWizardCommon.iss"
;
;   What four suite-wide capabilities live here?
;     1. Automatic Packaging of 'RaggieSoftUpdate.exe' (Zero-Runtime C++20 Updater):
;        If 'RaggieSoftUpdate.exe' has been compiled in '..\RaggieSoftUpdate\bin\...\Release\',
;        every RaggieSoft installer bundles it into '{autopf}\RaggieSoft\Update\' and
;        registers 'HKA\Software\RaggieSoft\Update\ExecutablePath' so 'Check for Updates'
;        works immediately whether the user installed one app or the whole suite!
;
;     2. Express vs. Custom Installation Mode Wizard Page:
;        Right after the License screen, offers a clean 2-option radio choice:
;          (*) Express Setup (Recommended) — One-click setup using sensible defaults
;              (automatically skips Destination Folder, Start Menu Folder, and Tasks!).
;          ( ) Custom Setup — Choose your installation folder, Start Menu & Desktop
;              shortcuts, and file/protocol preferences step by step.
;        Also honors CLI flags '/SETUPTYPE=EXPRESS' or '/SETUPTYPE=CUSTOM'.
;
;     3. Custom Ready-to-Install Summary Builder ('FormatRaggieSoftReadyMemo'):
;        Displays a crisp human-readable summary on 'wpReady' showing Setup Mode,
;        Destination, Shortcuts, Associations, and whether Microsoft .NET 10 Desktop
;        Runtime is already installed on this PC!
;
;     4. Multi-User HKCU Classes Cleanup via Windows 'Active Setup':
;        When an Administrator uninstalls an app on a shared family/work PC, other
;        user accounts on that PC cannot have their 'HKCU\Software\Classes\...' hives
;        edited while they are signed out. Writing a tiny one-shot 'reg.exe delete'
;        entry under 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components' tells
;        Windows Explorer to clean up any stale per-user association automatically the
;        next time each other user signs in — zero separate "Removal Tool" needed!
; ================================================================================

; --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; [Files] & [Registry]: Bundle RaggieSoftUpdate.exe automatically whenever compiled
; --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define SharedUpdaterX64 "..\RaggieSoftUpdate\bin\x64\Release\RaggieSoftUpdate.exe"
#define SharedUpdaterArm64 "..\RaggieSoftUpdate\bin\ARM64\Release\RaggieSoftUpdate.exe"

[Files]
#if FileExists(SharedUpdaterX64)
Source: "{#SharedUpdaterX64}"; DestDir: "{autopf}\RaggieSoft\Update"; Flags: ignoreversion uninsneveruninstall; Check: not IsArm64
#endif
#if FileExists(SharedUpdaterArm64)
Source: "{#SharedUpdaterArm64}"; DestDir: "{autopf}\RaggieSoft\Update"; Flags: ignoreversion uninsneveruninstall; Check: IsArm64
#endif

[Registry]
#if FileExists(SharedUpdaterX64) || FileExists(SharedUpdaterArm64)
Root: HKA; Subkey: "Software\RaggieSoft\Update"; ValueType: string; ValueName: "ExecutablePath"; ValueData: "{autopf}\RaggieSoft\Update\RaggieSoftUpdate.exe"
#endif

; --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; [Code]: Express vs. Custom Wizard Page, Ready Memo & Multi-User Active Setup Stub
; --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[Code]
var
  RaggieSoftInstallModePage: TWizardPage;
  ExpressModeRadio: TNewRadioButton;
  CustomModeRadio: TNewRadioButton;

// Checks CLI for '/SETUPTYPE=CUSTOM' so power users can pre-select Custom mode
function HasCustomSetupTypeCliFlag(): Boolean;
var
  I: Integer;
  UpperArg: String;
begin
  Result := False;
  for I := 1 to ParamCount do
  begin
    UpperArg := Uppercase(Trim(ParamStr(I)));
    if (UpperArg = '/SETUPTYPE=CUSTOM') or (UpperArg = '/CUSTOM') then
    begin
      Result := True;
      Exit;
    end;
  end;
end;

// Creates the Express vs. Custom Installation Mode radio page right after wpLicense
procedure InitRaggieSoftExpressCustomPage(const ExpressSummaryLine, CustomSummaryLine: String);
var
  IntroText, ExpressDesc, CustomDesc: TNewStaticText;
  DefaultCustom: Boolean;
begin
  DefaultCustom := HasCustomSetupTypeCliFlag();

  RaggieSoftInstallModePage := CreateCustomPage(
    wpLicense,
    'Choose Installation Type',
    'Select Express Setup for recommended defaults, or Custom Setup to tailor folders and shortcuts.');

  IntroText := TNewStaticText.Create(RaggieSoftInstallModePage);
  IntroText.Parent := RaggieSoftInstallModePage.Surface;
  IntroText.Left := ScaleX(0);
  IntroText.Top := ScaleY(0);
  IntroText.Width := RaggieSoftInstallModePage.SurfaceWidth;
  IntroText.WordWrap := True;
  IntroText.AutoSize := True;
  IntroText.Caption := 'How would you like to install {#MyAppName}?';

  ExpressModeRadio := TNewRadioButton.Create(RaggieSoftInstallModePage);
  ExpressModeRadio.Parent := RaggieSoftInstallModePage.Surface;
  ExpressModeRadio.Left := ScaleX(0);
  ExpressModeRadio.Top := IntroText.Top + IntroText.Height + ScaleY(14);
  ExpressModeRadio.Width := RaggieSoftInstallModePage.SurfaceWidth;
  ExpressModeRadio.Height := ScaleY(22);
  ExpressModeRadio.Font.Style := [fsBold];
  ExpressModeRadio.Caption := 'Express Setup (Recommended)';
  ExpressModeRadio.Checked := not DefaultCustom;

  ExpressDesc := TNewStaticText.Create(RaggieSoftInstallModePage);
  ExpressDesc.Parent := RaggieSoftInstallModePage.Surface;
  ExpressDesc.Left := ScaleX(22);
  ExpressDesc.Top := ExpressModeRadio.Top + ExpressModeRadio.Height + ScaleY(2);
  ExpressDesc.Width := RaggieSoftInstallModePage.SurfaceWidth - ScaleX(22);
  ExpressDesc.WordWrap := True;
  ExpressDesc.AutoSize := True;
  ExpressDesc.Caption := ExpressSummaryLine;

  CustomModeRadio := TNewRadioButton.Create(RaggieSoftInstallModePage);
  CustomModeRadio.Parent := RaggieSoftInstallModePage.Surface;
  CustomModeRadio.Left := ScaleX(0);
  CustomModeRadio.Top := ExpressDesc.Top + ExpressDesc.Height + ScaleY(18);
  CustomModeRadio.Width := RaggieSoftInstallModePage.SurfaceWidth;
  CustomModeRadio.Height := ScaleY(22);
  CustomModeRadio.Font.Style := [fsBold];
  CustomModeRadio.Caption := 'Custom Setup';
  CustomModeRadio.Checked := DefaultCustom;

  CustomDesc := TNewStaticText.Create(RaggieSoftInstallModePage);
  CustomDesc.Parent := RaggieSoftInstallModePage.Surface;
  CustomDesc.Left := ScaleX(22);
  CustomDesc.Top := CustomModeRadio.Top + CustomModeRadio.Height + ScaleY(2);
  CustomDesc.Width := RaggieSoftInstallModePage.SurfaceWidth - ScaleX(22);
  CustomDesc.WordWrap := True;
  CustomDesc.AutoSize := True;
  CustomDesc.Caption := CustomSummaryLine;
end;

function IsRaggieSoftExpressMode(): Boolean;
begin
  Result := (ExpressModeRadio <> nil) and ExpressModeRadio.Checked;
end;

// Skips folder/group/tasks pages automatically when Express Setup is chosen
function ShouldSkipStandardPagesInExpressMode(const PageID: Integer): Boolean;
begin
  Result := False;
  if IsRaggieSoftExpressMode() then
  begin
    if (PageID = wpSelectDir) or (PageID = wpSelectProgramGroup) or (PageID = wpSelectTasks) then
      Result := True;
  end;
end;

// Formats a clean Ready-to-Install overview memo (including .NET 10 runtime status!)
function FormatRaggieSoftReadyMemo(
  const Space, NewLine, MemoUserInfoInfo, MemoDirInfo, MemoTypeInfo,
  MemoComponentsInfo, MemoGroupInfo, MemoTasksInfo, ExtraCustomLines: String;
  const DotNetAlreadyPresent: Boolean): String;
var
  S: String;
begin
  S := 'Installation Mode:' + NewLine + Space;
  if IsRaggieSoftExpressMode() then
    S := S + 'Express Setup (Recommended defaults)' + NewLine + NewLine
  else
    S := S + 'Custom Setup' + NewLine + NewLine;

  if MemoDirInfo <> '' then
    S := S + MemoDirInfo + NewLine + NewLine;

  if MemoGroupInfo <> '' then
    S := S + MemoGroupInfo + NewLine + NewLine;

  if MemoTasksInfo <> '' then
    S := S + MemoTasksInfo + NewLine + NewLine;

  if ExtraCustomLines <> '' then
    S := S + ExtraCustomLines + NewLine + NewLine;

  S := S + 'Runtime Status:' + NewLine + Space;
  if DotNetAlreadyPresent then
    S := S + 'Microsoft .NET 10 Desktop Runtime is already installed (no extra download needed).'
  else
    S := S + 'Microsoft .NET 10 Desktop Runtime will be downloaded and installed automatically.';

  Result := S;
end;

// Registers a lightweight Windows Active Setup stub on Admin Uninstall so any OTHER
// user accounts on the same PC automatically clean up stale per-user HKCU\Software\Classes
// entries the next time they sign into Windows (zero external removal tool required!).
procedure RegisterMultiUserHkcuClassesCleanupStub(const ComponentGuid, ClassSubKeyName: String);
var
  ActiveSetupKey, CmdLine: String;
begin
  if not IsAdminInstallMode then
    Exit;

  ActiveSetupKey := 'SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\' + ComponentGuid;
  CmdLine := ExpandConstant('{sys}\reg.exe') + ' delete "HKCU\Software\Classes\' + ClassSubKeyName + '" /f';

  RegWriteStringValue(HKLM64, ActiveSetupKey, '', '{#MyAppName} Per-User Cleanup');
  RegWriteStringValue(HKLM64, ActiveSetupKey, 'StubPath', CmdLine);
  RegWriteStringValue(HKLM64, ActiveSetupKey, 'Version', '2,0,' + GetDateTimeString('yyyymmdd,hhnnss', '', ''));
end;

StoreTrainer.iss (StoreTrainer 2.0 — Express/Custom Setup & Classic Upgrade Script)

Modern StoreTrainer 2.0 setup script with Express/Custom modes, Launch vs. Edit double-click selection, and in-place upgrade from classic StoreTrainer 1.0 & 1.1.

; ================================================================================
; FILE: StoreTrainer.iss
; APPLICATION: RaggieSoft StoreTrainer 2.0
; COMPILER: Inno Setup 7.1.1 (Native 64-Bit ISCC.exe at C:\Program Files\Inno Setup 7)
; ARCHITECTURES: Native AMD64 (win-x64) & Native ARM64 (win-arm64)
; LICENSE: MIT License (Application Code) / CC BY-SA 4.0 (Documentation & Artwork)
;
; PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
;   What is this file?
;     This '.iss' file compiles 'RaggieSoft-StoreTrainer-Setup.exe' inside '..\Installers\'.
;     It brings together:
;       1. Express vs. Custom Installation Mode (via 'SharedInno\RaggieSoftWizardCommon.iss'),
;          plus a Custom Setup page choosing whether double-clicking a '.stfx' file
;          launches your game & trainer immediately ('/l') or opens the editor ('/e')!
;       2. Modern '.stfx' ('Documents\StoreFiles\') and optional classic '.stf' file
;          associations, plus 'raggiesoft-storetrainer://' deep links and automatic
;          deployment of our zero-runtime C++20 updater ('RaggieSoftUpdate.exe').
;       3. Surgical NSIS-to-Inno Setup Upgrade (v1.0 / v1.1 -> v2.0):
;          Never touches 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\' VB6 runtime files or 'Documents\My StoreFiles\*.stf';
;          surgically removes only StoreTrainer's legacy 32-bit files and Uninstall key.
;       4. Multi-User 'HKCU\Software\Classes' Cleanup via Windows 'Active Setup' on
;          Admin uninstall so other user accounts on a shared PC never need an external
;          "File Associations Removal Tool"!
; ================================================================================

function GetStoreFileDefaultVerb(Param: String): String;
begin
  if (DoubleClickVerbPage <> nil) and (not IsRaggieSoftExpressMode()) and (DoubleClickVerbPage.SelectedValueIndex = 1) then
    Result := 'edit'
  else
    Result := 'open';
end;

function DetectLegacyNsisInstallFolder(): String;
var
  DirVal, UninsVal: String;
begin
  Result := '';
  if RegQueryStringValue(HKLM32, 'Software\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer', 'Installation Folder', DirVal) and (Trim(DirVal) <> '') then
  begin
    Result := RemoveBackslashUnlessRoot(Trim(DirVal));
    Exit;
  end;

  if RegQueryStringValue(HKLM32, 'Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\RaggieSoft StoreTrainer', 'UninstallString', UninsVal) and (Trim(UninsVal) <> '') then
  begin
    Result := RemoveBackslashUnlessRoot(ExtractFileDir(RemoveQuotes(Trim(UninsVal))));
    Exit;
  end;
end;

procedure PerformSurgicalLegacyNsisCleanup();
var
  ParentDir: String;
begin
  if (LegacyNsisInstallDir = '') or (not DirExists(LegacyNsisInstallDir)) then
    Exit;

  if (not FileExists(LegacyNsisInstallDir + '\TStore.exe')) and (not FileExists(LegacyNsisInstallDir + '\uninstall.exe')) then
    Exit;

  Log('Upgrading classic NSIS StoreTrainer installation at: ' + LegacyNsisInstallDir);

  if DirExists(LegacyNsisInstallDir + '\Source') then
    DelTree(LegacyNsisInstallDir + '\Source', True, True, True);

  DeleteFile(LegacyNsisInstallDir + '\TStore.exe');
  DeleteFile(LegacyNsisInstallDir + '\TStore.exe.manifest');
  DeleteFile(LegacyNsisInstallDir + '\LICENSE.rtf');
  DeleteFile(LegacyNsisInstallDir + '\License.rtf');
  DeleteFile(LegacyNsisInstallDir + '\README.txt');
  DeleteFile(LegacyNsisInstallDir + '\TStore.ini');
  DeleteFile(LegacyNsisInstallDir + '\uninstall.exe');

  ParentDir := ExtractFileDir(LegacyNsisInstallDir);
  RemoveDir(LegacyNsisInstallDir);
  if ParentDir <> '' then
    RemoveDir(ParentDir);
end;

function GetDotNetInstallerUrl(): String;
begin
  if IsArm64 then
    Result := '{#DotNet10DesktopArm64Url}'
  else
    Result := '{#DotNet10DesktopX64Url}';
end;

function GetDotNetInstallerFileName(Param: String): String;
begin
  if IsArm64 then
    Result := '{#DotNet10DesktopArm64File}'
  else
    Result := '{#DotNet10DesktopX64File}';
end;

function IsDotNet10DesktopInstalled(): Boolean;
var
  ValueNames: TArrayOfString;
  I: Integer;
  FindRec: TFindRec;
  ArchKey, SharedDir: String;
begin
  Result := False;
  if IsArm64 then
    ArchKey := 'SOFTWARE\dotnet\Setup\InstalledVersions\arm64\sharedfx\Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App'
  else
    ArchKey := 'SOFTWARE\dotnet\Setup\InstalledVersions\x64\sharedfx\Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App';

  if RegGetValueNames(HKLM64, ArchKey, ValueNames) then
  begin
    for I := 0 to GetArrayLength(ValueNames) - 1 do
    begin
      if Pos('10.0.', ValueNames[I]) = 1 then
      begin
        Result := True;
        Exit;
      end;
    end;
  end;

  SharedDir := ExpandConstant('{commonpf64}\dotnet\shared\Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App');
  if FindFirst(SharedDir + '\10.0.*', FindRec) then
  begin
    try
      repeat
        if (FindRec.Attributes and FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) <> 0 then
        begin
          Result := True;
          Exit;
        end;
      until not FindNext(FindRec);
    finally
      FindClose(FindRec);
    end;
  end;
end;

function ShouldInstallDownloadedDotNet10Runtime(): Boolean;
begin
  Result := DotNet10RuntimeDownloaded and FileExists(ExpandConstant('{tmp}\') + GetDotNetInstallerFileName(''));
end;

function InitializeSetup(): Boolean;
begin
  LegacyNsisInstallDir := DetectLegacyNsisInstallFolder();
  Result := True;
end;

procedure InitializeWizard;
begin
  DotNet10RuntimeDownloaded := False;

  // 1. Shared Express vs. Custom Installation Mode page
  InitRaggieSoftExpressCustomPage(
    'Installs {#MyAppName} into the default RaggieSoft folder, creates shortcuts, registers .stfx game profiles (double-click to launch), and preserves any classic My StoreFiles.',
    'Lets you pick a custom installation folder, choose Start Menu and Desktop shortcuts, toggle .stfx / .stf file associations, and pick your preferred double-click behavior.');

  // 2. Custom Setup Double-Click Action page (modeled on classic StoreTrainer IS2010PR Setup.Rul!)
  DoubleClickVerbPage := CreateInputOptionPage(
    wpSelectTasks,
    'StoreFile (.stfx) Double-Click Behavior',
    'Choose what happens when you double-click a saved .stfx game profile in File Explorer.',
    'Both "Launch Game & Trainer" and "Edit in RaggieSoft StoreTrainer" remain available anytime in the right-click menu:',
    True,
    False);
  DoubleClickVerbPage.Add('Launch my game and companion trainer immediately (Recommended)');
  DoubleClickVerbPage.Add('Open the profile inside the StoreTrainer editor window');
  DoubleClickVerbPage.SelectedValueIndex := 0;

  DownloadPage := CreateDownloadPage(
    SetupMessage(msgWizardPreparing),
    'Downloading required Microsoft .NET 10 Desktop Runtime...',
    nil);
end;

function ShouldSkipPage(PageID: Integer): Boolean;
begin
  Result := ShouldSkipStandardPagesInExpressMode(PageID);
  if (not Result) and (PageID = DoubleClickVerbPage.ID) then
  begin
    if IsRaggieSoftExpressMode() or (not WizardIsTaskSelected('associate_stfx')) then
      Result := True;
  end;
end;

function UpdateReadyMemo(Space, NewLine, MemoUserInfoInfo, MemoDirInfo, MemoTypeInfo, MemoComponentsInfo, MemoGroupInfo, MemoTasksInfo: String): String;
var
  Extra: String;
begin
  Extra := 'StoreFile Double-Click Action:' + NewLine + Space;
  if GetStoreFileDefaultVerb('') = 'edit' then
    Extra := Extra + 'Open profile in StoreTrainer editor (/e)'
  else
    Extra := Extra + 'Launch game & trainer immediately (/l)';

  if LegacyNsisInstallDir <> '' then
    Extra := Extra + NewLine + NewLine + 'Classic Upgrade:' + NewLine + Space +
      'Upgrading classic StoreTrainer installation at ' + LegacyNsisInstallDir + ' (preserving My StoreFiles).';

  Result := FormatRaggieSoftReadyMemo(
    Space, NewLine, MemoUserInfoInfo, MemoDirInfo, MemoTypeInfo,
    MemoComponentsInfo, MemoGroupInfo, MemoTasksInfo, Extra,
    IsDotNet10DesktopInstalled());
end;

function NextButtonClick(CurPageID: Integer): Boolean;
begin
  Result := True;
  if (CurPageID = wpReady) and (not IsDotNet10DesktopInstalled()) then
  begin
    DownloadPage.Clear;
    DownloadPage.Add(GetDotNetInstallerUrl(), GetDotNetInstallerFileName(''), '');
    DownloadPage.Show;
    try
      try
        DownloadPage.Download;
        if FileExists(ExpandConstant('{tmp}\') + GetDotNetInstallerFileName('')) then
          DotNet10RuntimeDownloaded := True;
      except
        if not DownloadPage.AbortedByUser then
          SuppressibleMsgBox(
            'Unable to download Microsoft .NET 10 Desktop Runtime automatically: ' + AddPeriod(GetExceptionMessage),
            mbCriticalError, MB_OK, IDOK);
      end;
    finally
      DownloadPage.Hide;
    end;
  end;
end;

procedure CurStepChanged(CurStep: TSetupStep);
begin
  if CurStep = ssInstall then
  begin
    if IsAdminInstallMode then
      PerformSurgicalLegacyNsisCleanup();
  end;
end;

procedure InitializeUninstallProgressForm();
var
  IntroLabel, ProfilesNoteLabel, PrefsNoteLabel: TNewStaticText;
  UninstallNextButton: TNewButton;
  OrigPageName, OrigPageDesc: String;
  OrigCancelEnabled: Boolean;
begin
  UninstallRemoveProfiles := False;
  UninstallRemovePrefs := False;
  UninstallCleanOtherUsers := IsAdminInstallMode;

  if UninstallSilent then
    Exit;

  OrigPageName := UninstallProgressForm.PageNameLabel.Caption;
  OrigPageDesc := UninstallProgressForm.PageDescriptionLabel.Caption;
  OrigCancelEnabled := UninstallProgressForm.CancelButton.Enabled;

  UninstallProgressForm.PageNameLabel.Caption := 'Uninstall Options — Game Profiles & Associations';
  UninstallProgressForm.PageDescriptionLabel.Caption :=
    'Choose whether to keep or remove your saved StoreFiles game profiles, settings, and multi-user associations.';

  UninstallOptionsPage := TNewNotebookPage.Create(UninstallProgressForm);
  UninstallOptionsPage.Notebook := UninstallProgressForm.InnerNotebook;
  UninstallOptionsPage.Parent := UninstallProgressForm.InnerNotebook;
  UninstallOptionsPage.BoundsRect := UninstallProgressForm.InstallingPage.BoundsRect;

  IntroLabel := TNewStaticText.Create(UninstallProgressForm);
  IntroLabel.Parent := UninstallOptionsPage;
  IntroLabel.Left := ScaleX(0);
  IntroLabel.Top := ScaleY(0);
  IntroLabel.Width := UninstallOptionsPage.Width;
  IntroLabel.WordWrap := True;
  IntroLabel.AutoSize := True;
  IntroLabel.Caption :=
    'Setup will now remove {#MyAppName}. By default, your saved game profiles in Documents\StoreFiles ' +
    '(and any classic My StoreFiles) are kept safe.';

  RemoveProfilesCheckBox := TNewCheckBox.Create(UninstallProgressForm);
  RemoveProfilesCheckBox.Parent := UninstallOptionsPage;
  RemoveProfilesCheckBox.Left := ScaleX(0);
  RemoveProfilesCheckBox.Top := IntroLabel.Top + IntroLabel.Height + ScaleY(14);
  RemoveProfilesCheckBox.Width := UninstallOptionsPage.Width;
  RemoveProfilesCheckBox.Height := ScaleY(22);
  RemoveProfilesCheckBox.Caption := 'Remove my saved .stfx game profiles and save-game backups';
  RemoveProfilesCheckBox.Checked := False;

  ProfilesNoteLabel := TNewStaticText.Create(UninstallProgressForm);
  ProfilesNoteLabel.Parent := UninstallOptionsPage;
  ProfilesNoteLabel.Left := ScaleX(22);
  ProfilesNoteLabel.Top := RemoveProfilesCheckBox.Top + RemoveProfilesCheckBox.Height + ScaleY(2);
  ProfilesNoteLabel.Width := UninstallOptionsPage.Width - ScaleX(22);
  ProfilesNoteLabel.WordWrap := True;
  ProfilesNoteLabel.AutoSize := True;
  ProfilesNoteLabel.Caption :=
    'Leave unchecked to keep Documents\StoreFiles (classic Documents\My StoreFiles and your installed games are never touched).';

  RemovePrefsCheckBox := TNewCheckBox.Create(UninstallProgressForm);
  RemovePrefsCheckBox.Parent := UninstallOptionsPage;
  RemovePrefsCheckBox.Left := ScaleX(0);
  RemovePrefsCheckBox.Top := ProfilesNoteLabel.Top + ProfilesNoteLabel.Height + ScaleY(12);
  RemovePrefsCheckBox.Width := UninstallOptionsPage.Width;
  RemovePrefsCheckBox.Height := ScaleY(22);
  RemovePrefsCheckBox.Caption := 'Remove saved {#MyAppName} preferences';
  RemovePrefsCheckBox.Checked := False;

  PrefsNoteLabel := TNewStaticText.Create(UninstallProgressForm);
  PrefsNoteLabel.Parent := UninstallOptionsPage;
  PrefsNoteLabel.Left := ScaleX(22);
  PrefsNoteLabel.Top := RemovePrefsCheckBox.Top + RemovePrefsCheckBox.Height + ScaleY(2);
  PrefsNoteLabel.Width := UninstallOptionsPage.Width - ScaleX(22);
  PrefsNoteLabel.WordWrap := True;
  PrefsNoteLabel.AutoSize := True;
  PrefsNoteLabel.Caption :=
    'Leave unchecked to preserve your library path and theme preference for future updates.';

  if IsAdminInstallMode then
  begin
    CleanOtherUsersCheckBox := TNewCheckBox.Create(UninstallProgressForm);
    CleanOtherUsersCheckBox.Parent := UninstallOptionsPage;
    CleanOtherUsersCheckBox.Left := ScaleX(0);
    CleanOtherUsersCheckBox.Top := PrefsNoteLabel.Top + PrefsNoteLabel.Height + ScaleY(12);
    CleanOtherUsersCheckBox.Width := UninstallOptionsPage.Width;
    CleanOtherUsersCheckBox.Height := ScaleY(22);
    CleanOtherUsersCheckBox.Caption := 'Also clean up per-user .stfx file associations for other Windows accounts on next sign-in';
    CleanOtherUsersCheckBox.Checked := True;
  end;

  UninstallProgressForm.InnerNotebook.ActivePage := UninstallOptionsPage;

  UninstallNextButton := TNewButton.Create(UninstallProgressForm);
  UninstallNextButton.Parent := UninstallProgressForm;
  UninstallNextButton.Left :=
    UninstallProgressForm.CancelButton.Left - UninstallProgressForm.CancelButton.Width - ScaleX(10);
  UninstallNextButton.Top := UninstallProgressForm.CancelButton.Top;
  UninstallNextButton.Width := UninstallProgressForm.CancelButton.Width;
  UninstallNextButton.Height := UninstallProgressForm.CancelButton.Height;
  UninstallNextButton.Caption := '&Uninstall';
  UninstallNextButton.ModalResult := mrOk;
  UninstallNextButton.Default := True;
  UninstallNextButton.TabOrder := 0;

  UninstallProgressForm.CancelButton.Enabled := True;
  UninstallProgressForm.CancelButton.ModalResult := mrCancel;
  UninstallProgressForm.CancelButton.Cancel := True;
  UninstallProgressForm.CancelButton.TabOrder := 1;

  if UninstallProgressForm.ShowModal <> mrOk then
    Abort;

  UninstallRemoveProfiles := RemoveProfilesCheckBox.Checked;
  UninstallRemovePrefs := RemovePrefsCheckBox.Checked;
  if CleanOtherUsersCheckBox <> nil then
    UninstallCleanOtherUsers := CleanOtherUsersCheckBox.Checked;

  UninstallNextButton.Visible := False;
  UninstallProgressForm.PageNameLabel.Caption := OrigPageName;
  UninstallProgressForm.PageDescriptionLabel.Caption := OrigPageDesc;
  UninstallProgressForm.CancelButton.Enabled := OrigCancelEnabled;
  UninstallProgressForm.CancelButton.ModalResult := mrNone;
  UninstallProgressForm.InnerNotebook.ActivePage := UninstallProgressForm.InstallingPage;
end;

procedure CurUninstallStepChanged(CurUninstallStep: TUninstallStep);
var
  StoreFilesDir, SaveBackupsDir, RoamingDir, PrefsFile: String;
begin
  if CurUninstallStep = usUninstall then
  begin
    StoreFilesDir := ExpandConstant('{userdocs}\StoreFiles');
    SaveBackupsDir := ExpandConstant('{localappdata}\RaggieSoft\Cache\StoreTrainer');
    RoamingDir := ExpandConstant('{userappdata}\RaggieSoft');
    PrefsFile := RoamingDir + '\storetrainer-preferences.json';

    if UninstallRemoveProfiles then
    begin
      if DirExists(StoreFilesDir) then
        DelTree(StoreFilesDir, True, True, True);
      if DirExists(SaveBackupsDir) then
        DelTree(SaveBackupsDir, True, True, True);
    end;

    if UninstallRemovePrefs and FileExists(PrefsFile) then
    begin
      DeleteFile(PrefsFile);
      RemoveDir(RoamingDir);
    end;

    // Clean current user's per-user classes if present, and register Active Setup stub for OTHER accounts!
    RegDeleteKeyIncludingSubkeys(HKCU, 'Software\Classes\.stfx');
    RegDeleteKeyIncludingSubkeys(HKCU, 'Software\Classes\RaggieSoft.StoreFileX');
    RegDeleteKeyIncludingSubkeys(HKCU, 'Software\Classes\raggiesoft-storetrainer');

    if UninstallCleanOtherUsers and IsAdminInstallMode then
    begin
      RegisterMultiUserHkcuClassesCleanupStub('{8E92D4A1-63F0-4C8B-9B7A-10164500B004}_STFX', 'RaggieSoft.StoreFileX');
      RegisterMultiUserHkcuClassesCleanupStub('{8E92D4A1-63F0-4C8B-9B7A-10164500B004}_EXT', '.stfx');
      RegisterMultiUserHkcuClassesCleanupStub('{8E92D4A1-63F0-4C8B-9B7A-10164500B004}_URI', 'raggiesoft-storetrainer');
    end;
  end;
end;

vb6-v1.1/Installer/TSSetup.nsi (Classic v1.1 Full Retro Setup — Windows 95 Compatible)

ANSI-mode NSIS setup script for vintage Windows 95 through modern PCs, registering .stf file associations and RaggieSoft Launcher discovery.

; ==============================================================================
; FILE: TSSetup.nsi
; APPLICATION: RaggieSoft StoreTrainer v1.1 (Classic Visual Basic 6.0 Edition)
; COMPILER: Nullsoft Scriptable Install System (NSIS 2.x or NSIS 3.x in ANSI Mode)
; TARGET OS: Windows 95, 98, ME, NT 4.0 SP3+, 2000 SP4, XP, Vista, 7, 8.1, 10, 11
; LICENSE: MIT License
;
; PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
;   What is this file?
;     This '.nsi' script compiles 'tssetup110.exe' — the full retro installer for
;     classic 32-bit Visual Basic 6.0 StoreTrainer v1.1!
;
;   Why stay on NSIS with 'Unicode false' for v1.1 while v2.0 uses Inno Setup 7?
;     - Inno Setup 7 requires Windows 7 SP1 / Windows 10+ and 64-bit CPUs.
;     - By declaring 'Unicode false' right at the top of this NSIS script, NSIS 3
;       compiles an x86 ANSI installer stub using '*A' Win32 APIs that genuinely
;       runs on vintage Windows 95, Windows 98, and Windows 2000 retro gaming PCs!
;
;   What did v1.1 fix and add compared to v1.0's TSSetup.nsi?
;     1. Explicit 'Unicode false' so NSIS 3 preserves Windows 95 compatibility.
;     2. Fixed v1.0's two bugs: '$TSSETUP' -> '$TSTORESETUP' version-compare variable
;        typo in '.onInit', and 'Software\Microsoft Windows\...' missing backslash
;        in 'Section "Uninstall"' (while also cleaning up any leftover v1.0 typo key!).
;     3. Checks our named Win32 Mutex ('RaggieSoft_StoreTrainer_Mutex') before
;        overwriting 'TStore.exe'.
;     4. Registers '.stf' file associations ('open' -> '/l "%1"', 'edit' -> '/e "%1"').
;     5. Writes complete Uninstall metadata ('InstallLocation', 'DisplayIcon',
;        'URLInfoAbout') so RaggieSoft Launcher automatically discovers StoreTrainer v1.1!
; ==============================================================================

; Force 32-bit ANSI installer stub in NSIS 3.x so Windows 95 / 98 / ME are supported!
Unicode false

!ifndef SETUP_OUTFILE
  !define SETUP_OUTFILE "tssetup110.exe"
!endif

Var CompanyName
Var ProductName
Var DCOM98INSTALL
Var DCOM98RETURN
Var SCRRUNVER
Var SCRRUNDLL
Var scr_exit_code
Var TSTOREVER
Var UNINSREG
Var IS_INSTALLED
Var TSTORESETUP
Var hMutexCheck

; Use InstallSpider UI if installed in NSIS\Include, otherwise fall back cleanly to MUI2
!include /NONFATAL "ISUI.nsh"
!ifndef MUI_PAGE_WELCOME
  !include "MUI2.nsh"
!endif
!include "LogicLib.nsh"
!include "WinVer.nsh"
!include "Library.nsh"
!include "FileFunc.nsh"
!include "WordFunc.nsh"

Name "$CompanyName $ProductName"
OutFile "${SETUP_OUTFILE}"
BrandingText "$CompanyName"

ShowInstDetails show
ShowUninstDetails show

InstallDir "$PROGRAMFILES\$CompanyName\$ProductName"
InstallDirRegKey HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Installation Folder"

XPStyle on
RequestExecutionLevel admin
ManifestSupportedOS all

!getdllversion "..\Build\TStore.exe" Expv_

VIProductVersion "${Expv_1}.${Expv_2}.${Expv_3}.${Expv_4}"
VIAddVersionKey "ProductName" "$ProductName"
VIAddVersionKey "Comments" "Classic Retro Edition (Windows 95 through Windows 11)"
VIAddVersionKey "CompanyName" "$CompanyName"
VIAddVersionKey "LegalTrademarks" "$ProductName is a creative imprint utility of $CompanyName"
VIAddVersionKey "LegalCopyright" "Copyright (C) 2018-2026 Michael P. Ragsdale (MIT License)"
VIAddVersionKey "FileDescription" "Stores the locations of games and trainers"
VIAddVersionKey "FileVersion" "${Expv_1}.${Expv_2}.${Expv_3}.${Expv_4}"

; Wizard Pages
!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_WELCOME
  !define MUI_LICENSEPAGE_RADIOBUTTONS
  !define MUI_LICENSEPAGE_RADIOBUTTONS_TEXT_ACCEPT "I &Accept"
  !define MUI_LICENSEPAGE_RADIOBUTTONS_TEXT_DECLINE "I &Decline"
!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_LICENSE "License\LICENSE.rtf"
!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_DIRECTORY
!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_INSTFILES
  !define MUI_FINISHPAGE_RUN "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe"
  !define MUI_FINISHPAGE_RUN_TEXT "&Launch $ProductName"
  !define MUI_FINISHPAGE_LINK "&Visit the $ProductName Website"
  !define MUI_FINISHPAGE_LINK_LOCATION "https://storetrainer.raggiesoft.com/"
!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_FINISH

!insertmacro MUI_UNPAGE_WELCOME
!insertmacro MUI_UNPAGE_CONFIRM
!insertmacro MUI_UNPAGE_INSTFILES
!insertmacro MUI_UNPAGE_FINISH

!insertmacro MUI_LANGUAGE "English"

; ==============================================================================
; SECTION 1: Legacy VB6 / DCOM98 / WSH 5.6 Runtime Libraries (NEVER UNINSTALL!)
; ==============================================================================
Section "-Required System Components" SysComp
  DetailPrint "Checking Microsoft Visual Basic 6.0 Runtime..."
  !insertmacro InstallLib REGDLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\msvbvm60.dll" "$SYSDIR\msvbvm60.dll" "$SYSDIR"
  !insertmacro InstallLib REGDLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\oleaut32.dll" "$SYSDIR\oleaut32.dll" "$SYSDIR"
  !insertmacro InstallLib REGDLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\olepro32.dll" "$SYSDIR\olepro32.dll" "$SYSDIR"
  !insertmacro InstallLib REGDLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\comcat.dll" "$SYSDIR\comcat.dll" "$SYSDIR"
  !insertmacro InstallLib DLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\asycfilt.dll" "$SYSDIR\asycfilt.dll" "$SYSDIR"
  !insertmacro InstallLib TLB "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\stdole2.tlb" "$SYSDIR\stdole2.tlb" "$SYSDIR"

  DetailPrint "Checking Windows Common Controls & Dialogs..."
  !insertmacro InstallLib REGDLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\comct232.ocx" "$SYSDIR\comct232.ocx" "$SYSDIR"
  !insertmacro InstallLib REGDLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\comctl32.ocx" "$SYSDIR\comctl32.ocx" "$SYSDIR"
  !insertmacro InstallLib REGDLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\comdlg32.ocx" "$SYSDIR\comdlg32.ocx" "$SYSDIR"
  !insertmacro InstallLib REGDLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\wshom.ocx" "$SYSDIR\wshom.ocx" "$SYSDIR"

  SetOutPath $TEMP
  File "Microsoft Redist\DCOM98\DCOM98.exe"
  File "Microsoft Redist\WSH56\WScr9x.exe"
  File "Microsoft Redist\WSH56\WScrNT2k.exe"

  ${IfNot} ${IsNT}
    ReadRegStr $DCOM98INSTALL HKCR "CLSID\{bdc67890-4fc0-11d0-a805-00aa006d2ea4}" "InstalledVersion"
    ${If} $DCOM98INSTALL == ""
      DetailPrint "Installing DCOM98 for Windows 95/98..."
      ExecWait "$\"$TEMP\DCOM98.exe$\" /r:n /q:u" $DCOM98RETURN
      SetRebootFlag true
    ${EndIf}
  ${EndIf}

  ${GetFileVersion} "$SYSDIR\scrrun.dll" $SCRRUNDLL
  ${VersionCompare} "5.6" $SCRRUNDLL $SCRRUNVER
  ${If} $SCRRUNVER == "1"
    ${If} ${IsNT}
      ${If} ${AtMostWin2000}
        DetailPrint "Installing Windows Script Host 5.6 for Windows NT 4.0 / 2000..."
        ExecWait "$\"$TEMP\WScrNT2k.exe$\" /q /r:n" $scr_exit_code
        SetRebootFlag true
      ${EndIf}
    ${Else}
      DetailPrint "Installing Windows Script Host 5.6 for Windows 95 / 98..."
      ExecWait "$\"$TEMP\WScr9x.exe$\" /q /r:n" $scr_exit_code
      SetRebootFlag true
    ${EndIf}
  ${EndIf}
SectionEnd

; ==============================================================================
; SECTION 2: Core StoreTrainer v1.1 Binary, File Associations & Launcher Keys
; ==============================================================================
Section "$CompanyName $ProductName" TStoreBase
  SetShellVarContext all

  SetOutPath $INSTDIR
  SetOverwrite ifnewer
  DetailPrint "Installing $CompanyName $ProductName..."
  File "..\Build\TStore.exe"
  File "..\Build\TStore.exe.manifest"
  File "..\README.txt"
  File "License\LICENSE.rtf"

  ${GetFileVersion} "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe" $TSTOREVER

  CreateShortcut "$SMPROGRAMS\$ProductName.lnk" "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe" "" "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe" 0 SW_SHOWNORMAL "" "$ProductName stores the locations of your games and trainers"

  ; Application state Registry keys (also read by TSSetup-Patch.nsi and StoreTrainer 2.0's upgrader)
  WriteRegStr HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Installation Folder" "$INSTDIR"
  WriteRegStr HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Product Version" "$TSTOREVER"
  WriteRegStr HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "SMFolder" "$SMPROGRAMS"
  WriteRegStr HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Uninstall Key Location" "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$CompanyName $ProductName"

  ; Register '.stf' StoreFile association (double-click launches via '/l', right-click edits via '/e')
  WriteRegStr HKCR ".stf" "" "RaggieSoft.StoreFile"
  WriteRegStr HKCR "RaggieSoft.StoreFile" "" "RaggieSoft StoreTrainer Profile"
  WriteRegStr HKCR "RaggieSoft.StoreFile\DefaultIcon" "" "$\"$INSTDIR\TStore.exe$\",0"
  WriteRegStr HKCR "RaggieSoft.StoreFile\shell\open" "" "Launch Game & Trainer"
  WriteRegStr HKCR "RaggieSoft.StoreFile\shell\open\command" "" "$\"$INSTDIR\TStore.exe$\" /l $\"%1$\""
  WriteRegStr HKCR "RaggieSoft.StoreFile\shell\edit" "" "Edit in RaggieSoft StoreTrainer"
  WriteRegStr HKCR "RaggieSoft.StoreFile\shell\edit\command" "" "$\"$INSTDIR\TStore.exe$\" /e $\"%1$\""

  WriteINIStr "$INSTDIR\TStore.ini" "General" "Version" "$TSTOREVER"
  WriteINIStr "$INSTDIR\TStore.ini" "General" "Path" "$INSTDIR"
SectionEnd

; ==============================================================================
; SECTION 3: Windows Uninstall & RaggieSoft Launcher Discovery Keys
;   (Note: Bundled VB6 source code was retired in v1.1 since the complete
;    multi-generation source archive is published at github.com/raggiesoft/storetrainer.)
; ==============================================================================
Section "-Uninstall Registry Keys" Unins
  DetailPrint "Registering Uninstaller & RaggieSoft Launcher Metadata..."
  StrCpy $UNINSREG "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$CompanyName $ProductName"

  ${GetFileVersion} "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe" $R0

  ; Clean up v1.0's historical 'Microsoft Windows' typo key if present from an older install
  DeleteRegKey HKLM "Software\Microsoft Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$CompanyName $ProductName"

  WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "DisplayName" "$CompanyName $ProductName"
  WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "DisplayVersion" $R0
  WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "Publisher" "$CompanyName"
  WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "InstallLocation" "$INSTDIR"
  WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "DisplayIcon" "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe,0"
  WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "UninstallString" "$\"$INSTDIR\uninstall.exe$\""
  WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "URLInfoAbout" "https://storetrainer.raggiesoft.com/"
  WriteRegDWORD HKLM $UNINSREG "NoModify" 1
  WriteRegDWORD HKLM $UNINSREG "NoRepair" 1

  WriteUninstaller "$INSTDIR\uninstall.exe"
SectionEnd

Section "-Cleanup" Cleanup
  Delete "$TEMP\DCOM98.exe"
  Delete "$TEMP\WScr9x.exe"
  Delete "$TEMP\WScrNT2k.exe"
SectionEnd

; ==============================================================================
; UNINSTALL SECTION (Leaves shared VB6 system DLLs & user My StoreFiles safe!)
; ==============================================================================
Section "Uninstall"
  SetShellVarContext all
  ReadRegStr $INSTDIR HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Installation Folder"

  DetailPrint "Removing Registry Keys..."
  DeleteRegKey HKLM "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$CompanyName $ProductName"
  DeleteRegKey HKLM "Software\Microsoft Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$CompanyName $ProductName"
  DeleteRegKey HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName"
  DeleteRegKey /ifempty HKLM "Software\$CompanyName"
  DeleteRegKey HKCR "RaggieSoft.StoreFile"
  DeleteRegValue HKCR ".stf" ""

  DetailPrint "Removing $ProductName Application Files..."
  RMDir /r /REBOOTOK "$INSTDIR\Source"
  Delete "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe"
  Delete "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe.manifest"
  Delete "$INSTDIR\LICENSE.rtf"
  Delete "$INSTDIR\License.rtf"
  Delete "$INSTDIR\README.txt"
  Delete "$INSTDIR\TStore.ini"
  Delete "$INSTDIR\uninstall.exe"
  RMDir "$INSTDIR"
  RMDir "$PROGRAMFILES\$CompanyName"

  DetailPrint "Removing Start Menu Shortcut..."
  Delete "$SMPROGRAMS\$ProductName.lnk"
SectionEnd

Function .onInit
  StrCpy $CompanyName "RaggieSoft"
  StrCpy $ProductName "StoreTrainer"

  ${If} $INSTDIR == ""
    StrCpy $INSTDIR "$PROGRAMFILES\$CompanyName\$ProductName"
  ${EndIf}

  ${If} ${IsNT}
    UserInfo::GetAccountType
    Pop $0
    ${If} $0 != "admin"
      MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP|MB_OK "Administrator rights are required to install $ProductName!" /SD IDOK
      SetErrorLevel 740
      Quit
    ${EndIf}

    ${If} ${IsWinNT4}
      ${If} ${AtMostServicePack} 2
        MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP|MB_OK "Service Pack 3 or higher is required on Windows NT 4.0." /SD IDOK
        SetErrorLevel 3
        Quit
      ${EndIf}
    ${EndIf}
  ${EndIf}

  ; Check if TStore.exe (or StoreTrainer 2.0) is currently open via our shared Win32 Mutex
  System::Call 'kernel32::OpenMutexA(i 0x00100000, i 0, t "RaggieSoft_StoreTrainer_Mutex") i .r0'
  StrCpy $hMutexCheck $0
  ${If} $hMutexCheck != 0
    System::Call 'kernel32::CloseHandle(i $hMutexCheck)'
    MessageBox MB_ICONEXCLAMATION|MB_OK "Please close $CompanyName $ProductName before running Setup." /SD IDOK
    SetErrorLevel 6
    Quit
  ${EndIf}

  ; Check existing installed version ( supports clean v1.0 -> v1.1 and future v1.1.x upgrades! )
  ReadRegStr $IS_INSTALLED HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Installation Folder"
  IfFileExists "$IS_INSTALLED\TStore.exe" FileFound EndFileExistsTest
  FileFound:
    StrCpy $INSTDIR "$IS_INSTALLED"
    ${GetFileVersion} "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe" $R0
    ${GetFileVersion} "$EXEPATH" $R1
    ${VersionCompare} $R0 $R1 $TSTORESETUP

    ${If} $TSTORESETUP == 0
      Exec "$IS_INSTALLED\uninstall.exe"
      SetErrorLevel 4
      Quit
    ${ElseIf} $TSTORESETUP == 1
      MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP|MB_OK "A newer version of $ProductName ($R0) is already installed.$\r$\nSetup will now close." /SD IDOK
      SetErrorLevel 5
      Quit
    ${EndIf}
  EndFileExistsTest:
FunctionEnd

Function un.onInit
  StrCpy $CompanyName "RaggieSoft"
  StrCpy $ProductName "StoreTrainer"

  ${If} ${IsNT}
    UserInfo::GetAccountType
    Pop $0
    ${If} $0 != "admin"
      MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP|MB_OK "Administrator rights are required to uninstall $ProductName!" /SD IDOK
      SetErrorLevel 740
      Quit
    ${EndIf}
  ${EndIf}
FunctionEnd

vb6-v1.1/Installer/TSSetup-Patch.nsi (Classic v1.1 Lightweight Update Patcher)

Compact ANSI update utility patching StoreTrainer v1.0 to v1.1 (with support for future v1.1.x updates).

; ==============================================================================
; FILE: TSSetup-Patch.nsi
; APPLICATION: RaggieSoft StoreTrainer v1.1 In-Place Patcher (v1.0 -> v1.1 & v1.1.x)
; COMPILER: Nullsoft Scriptable Install System (NSIS 2.x or NSIS 3.x in ANSI Mode)
; TARGET OS: Windows 95, 98, ME, NT 4.0 SP3+, 2000 SP4, XP, Vista, 7, 8.1, 10, 11
; LICENSE: MIT License
;
; PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
;   What is this file?
;     While 'TSSetup.nsi' bundles ~4 MB of Visual Basic 6.0 / DCOM98 / WSH 5.6
;     redistributables for bare Windows 95/98 machines, 'TSSetup-Patch.nsi' builds
;     a tiny (~150 KB!) in-place patch installer ('tspatch110.exe') for anyone who
;     already has StoreTrainer v1.0 (or an earlier v1.1.x build) installed!
;
;   How does it leave room for future VB6 v1.1.x updates?
;     1. Reads the exact version straight out of '..\Build\TStore.exe' at compile
;        time via '!getdllversion' and compares it dynamically against the user's
;        installed '$INSTDIR\TStore.exe' via '${VersionCompare}'.
;     2. Supports overriding the output filename from the CLI without editing code:
;          makensis /DPATCH_OUTFILE=tspatch111.exe TSSetup-Patch.nsi
;     3. Upgrades v1.0's Registry keys in place so RaggieSoft Launcher immediately
;        discovers the newly patched VB6 v1.1 installation!
; ==============================================================================

; Force 32-bit ANSI stub so this patcher runs on Windows 95 / 98 / ME / 2000 SP4+
Unicode false

!ifndef PATCH_OUTFILE
  !define PATCH_OUTFILE "tspatch110.exe"
!endif

Var CompanyName
Var ProductName
Var PreviousInstallFolder
Var TStoreVersionInstalled
Var TStoreVersionPatch
Var TSVerCompare
Var TSTOREVER
Var UNINSREG
Var hMutexCheck

!include /NONFATAL "ISUI.nsh"
!ifndef MUI_PAGE_WELCOME
  !include "MUI2.nsh"
!endif
!include "LogicLib.nsh"
!include "WinVer.nsh"
!include "Library.nsh"
!include "FileFunc.nsh"
!include "WordFunc.nsh"

Name "$CompanyName $ProductName"
OutFile "${PATCH_OUTFILE}"
BrandingText "$CompanyName"

ShowInstDetails show
ShowUninstDetails show

InstallDir "$PROGRAMFILES\$CompanyName\$ProductName"
InstallDirRegKey HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Installation Folder"

XPStyle on
RequestExecutionLevel admin
ManifestSupportedOS all

!getdllversion "..\Build\TStore.exe" Expv_

VIProductVersion "${Expv_1}.${Expv_2}.${Expv_3}.${Expv_4}"
VIAddVersionKey "ProductName" "$ProductName Patch"
VIAddVersionKey "Comments" "Updates StoreTrainer v1.0 / v1.1.x to ${Expv_1}.${Expv_2}.${Expv_3}.${Expv_4}"
VIAddVersionKey "CompanyName" "$CompanyName"
VIAddVersionKey "LegalTrademarks" "$ProductName is a creative imprint utility of $CompanyName"
VIAddVersionKey "LegalCopyright" "Copyright (C) 2018-2026 Michael P. Ragsdale (MIT License)"
VIAddVersionKey "FileDescription" "In-place update patch for RaggieSoft StoreTrainer"
VIAddVersionKey "FileVersion" "${Expv_1}.${Expv_2}.${Expv_3}.${Expv_4}"

  !define MUI_WELCOMEPAGE_TITLE "$CompanyName $ProductName Update Patch"
  !define MUI_WELCOMEPAGE_TEXT "Welcome to the update utility for $CompanyName $ProductName.$\r$\n$\r$\nThis patch will update your installed copy of $ProductName from version $TStoreVersionInstalled to version ${Expv_1}.${Expv_2}.${Expv_3}.${Expv_4}, adding .stf Explorer file associations, /l & /e switches, launch delay support, and RaggieSoft Launcher discovery.$\r$\n$\r$\n$_CLICK"
!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_WELCOME
  !define MUI_LICENSEPAGE_RADIOBUTTONS
  !define MUI_LICENSEPAGE_RADIOBUTTONS_TEXT_ACCEPT "I &Accept"
  !define MUI_LICENSEPAGE_RADIOBUTTONS_TEXT_DECLINE "I &Decline"
!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_LICENSE "License\LICENSE.rtf"
!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_INSTFILES
  !define MUI_FINISHPAGE_RUN "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe"
  !define MUI_FINISHPAGE_RUN_TEXT "&Launch $ProductName"
  !define MUI_FINISHPAGE_LINK "&Visit the $ProductName Website"
  !define MUI_FINISHPAGE_LINK_LOCATION "https://storetrainer.raggiesoft.com/"
!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_FINISH

!insertmacro MUI_UNPAGE_WELCOME
!insertmacro MUI_UNPAGE_CONFIRM
!insertmacro MUI_UNPAGE_INSTFILES
!insertmacro MUI_UNPAGE_FINISH

!insertmacro MUI_LANGUAGE "English"

Section "$CompanyName $ProductName" TStoreBase
  SetShellVarContext all

  SetOutPath $INSTDIR
  SetOverwrite on
  DetailPrint "Updating $CompanyName $ProductName to ${Expv_1}.${Expv_2}.${Expv_3}.${Expv_4}..."
  File "..\Build\TStore.exe"
  File "..\Build\TStore.exe.manifest"
  File "..\README.txt"
  File "License\LICENSE.rtf"

  ${GetFileVersion} "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe" $TSTOREVER
  WriteINIStr "$INSTDIR\TStore.ini" "General" "Version" "$TSTOREVER"
  WriteINIStr "$INSTDIR\TStore.ini" "General" "Path" "$INSTDIR"

  CreateShortcut "$SMPROGRAMS\$ProductName.lnk" "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe" "" "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe" 0 SW_SHOWNORMAL "" "$ProductName stores the locations of your games and trainers"

  WriteRegStr HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Installation Folder" "$INSTDIR"
  WriteRegStr HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Product Version" "$TSTOREVER"
  WriteRegStr HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "SMFolder" "$SMPROGRAMS"
  WriteRegStr HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Uninstall Key Location" "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$CompanyName $ProductName"

  ; Register '.stf' StoreFile association (double-click launches via '/l', right-click edits via '/e')
  WriteRegStr HKCR ".stf" "" "RaggieSoft.StoreFile"
  WriteRegStr HKCR "RaggieSoft.StoreFile" "" "RaggieSoft StoreTrainer Profile"
  WriteRegStr HKCR "RaggieSoft.StoreFile\DefaultIcon" "" "$\"$INSTDIR\TStore.exe$\",0"
  WriteRegStr HKCR "RaggieSoft.StoreFile\shell\open" "" "Launch Game & Trainer"
  WriteRegStr HKCR "RaggieSoft.StoreFile\shell\open\command" "" "$\"$INSTDIR\TStore.exe$\" /l $\"%1$\""
  WriteRegStr HKCR "RaggieSoft.StoreFile\shell\edit" "" "Edit in RaggieSoft StoreTrainer"
  WriteRegStr HKCR "RaggieSoft.StoreFile\shell\edit\command" "" "$\"$INSTDIR\TStore.exe$\" /e $\"%1$\""

  ; If upgrading from v1.0 where '$INSTDIR\Source' was installed locally, remove the retired
  ; v1.0 Source folder so old 1.0 files don't sit beside a patched 1.1 binary (full source now
  ; lives permanently on GitHub at https://github.com/raggiesoft/storetrainer).
  IfFileExists "$INSTDIR\Source\*.*" 0 +2
    RMDir /r "$INSTDIR\Source"
SectionEnd

Section "-Uninstall Registry Keys" Unins
  DetailPrint "Refreshing Uninstaller & RaggieSoft Launcher Metadata..."
  StrCpy $UNINSREG "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$CompanyName $ProductName"
  ${GetFileVersion} "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe" $R0

  ; Remove v1.0's historical 'Microsoft Windows' typo key if present
  DeleteRegKey HKLM "Software\Microsoft Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$CompanyName $ProductName"

  WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "DisplayName" "$CompanyName $ProductName"
  WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "DisplayVersion" $R0
  WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "Publisher" "$CompanyName"
  WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "InstallLocation" "$INSTDIR"
  WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "DisplayIcon" "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe,0"
  WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "UninstallString" "$\"$INSTDIR\uninstall.exe$\""
  WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "URLInfoAbout" "https://storetrainer.raggiesoft.com/"
  WriteRegDWORD HKLM $UNINSREG "NoModify" 1
  WriteRegDWORD HKLM $UNINSREG "NoRepair" 1

  WriteUninstaller "$INSTDIR\uninstall.exe"
SectionEnd

; Complete NSIS Uninstaller (replaces v1.0's uninstaller so future uninstalls clean up properly!)
Section "Uninstall"
  SetShellVarContext all
  ReadRegStr $INSTDIR HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Installation Folder"

  DetailPrint "Removing Registry Keys..."
  DeleteRegKey HKLM "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$CompanyName $ProductName"
  DeleteRegKey HKLM "Software\Microsoft Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$CompanyName $ProductName"
  DeleteRegKey HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName"
  DeleteRegKey /ifempty HKLM "Software\$CompanyName"
  DeleteRegKey HKCR "RaggieSoft.StoreFile"
  DeleteRegValue HKCR ".stf" ""

  DetailPrint "Removing $ProductName Application Files..."
  RMDir /r /REBOOTOK "$INSTDIR\Source"
  Delete "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe"
  Delete "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe.manifest"
  Delete "$INSTDIR\LICENSE.rtf"
  Delete "$INSTDIR\License.rtf"
  Delete "$INSTDIR\README.txt"
  Delete "$INSTDIR\TStore.ini"
  Delete "$INSTDIR\uninstall.exe"
  RMDir "$INSTDIR"
  RMDir "$PROGRAMFILES\$CompanyName"

  DetailPrint "Removing Start Menu Shortcut..."
  Delete "$SMPROGRAMS\$ProductName.lnk"
SectionEnd

Function .onInit
  StrCpy $CompanyName "RaggieSoft"
  StrCpy $ProductName "StoreTrainer"
  StrCpy $INSTDIR "$PROGRAMFILES\$CompanyName\$ProductName"

  ${If} ${IsNT}
    UserInfo::GetAccountType
    Pop $0
    ${If} $0 != "admin"
      MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP|MB_OK "Administrator rights are required to update $ProductName!" /SD IDOK
      SetErrorLevel 740
      Quit
    ${EndIf}

    ${If} ${IsWinNT4}
      ${If} ${AtMostServicePack} 2
        MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP|MB_OK "Service Pack 3 or higher is required on Windows NT 4.0." /SD IDOK
        SetErrorLevel 3
        Quit
      ${EndIf}
    ${EndIf}
  ${EndIf}

  ; Ensure TStore.exe is closed before patching
  System::Call 'kernel32::OpenMutexA(i 0x00100000, i 0, t "RaggieSoft_StoreTrainer_Mutex") i .r0'
  StrCpy $hMutexCheck $0
  ${If} $hMutexCheck != 0
    System::Call 'kernel32::CloseHandle(i $hMutexCheck)'
    MessageBox MB_ICONEXCLAMATION|MB_OK "Please close $CompanyName $ProductName before applying this update." /SD IDOK
    SetErrorLevel 8
    Quit
  ${EndIf}

  ; Locate existing StoreTrainer v1.0 or earlier v1.1.x installation
  ReadRegStr $PreviousInstallFolder HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Installation Folder"
  IfFileExists "$PreviousInstallFolder\TStore.exe" file_found file_not_found
  file_not_found:
    MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP|MB_OK "This update requires $CompanyName $ProductName v1.0 or v1.1 to be installed first!" /SD IDOK
    SetErrorLevel 7
    Quit
  file_found:
    StrCpy $INSTDIR "$PreviousInstallFolder"
    ${GetFileVersion} "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe" $TStoreVersionInstalled
    StrCpy $TStoreVersionPatch "${Expv_1}.${Expv_2}.${Expv_3}.${Expv_4}"
    ${VersionCompare} "$TStoreVersionInstalled" "$TStoreVersionPatch" $TSVerCompare

    ${If} $TSVerCompare == 0
      MessageBox MB_ICONINFORMATION|MB_OK "$CompanyName $ProductName $TStoreVersionInstalled is already up to date!" /SD IDOK
      SetErrorLevel 5
      Quit
    ${ElseIf} $TSVerCompare == 1
      MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP|MB_OK "A newer version of $ProductName ($TStoreVersionInstalled) is already installed!" /SD IDOK
      SetErrorLevel 6
      Quit
    ${EndIf}
FunctionEnd

Function un.onInit
  StrCpy $CompanyName "RaggieSoft"
  StrCpy $ProductName "StoreTrainer"

  ${If} ${IsNT}
    UserInfo::GetAccountType
    Pop $0
    ${If} $0 != "admin"
      MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP|MB_OK "Administrator rights are required to uninstall $ProductName!" /SD IDOK
      SetErrorLevel 740
      Quit
    ${EndIf}
  ${EndIf}
FunctionEnd

archive/pre-ai-vb6/Installer/TSSetup.nsi (Frozen Pre-AI v1.0 Wizard95 Setup Script)

Untouched pre-AI NSIS Wizard95 installer script preserved for historical reference.

;In NSIS, all variables are GLOBAL

;Variables for the Product Information
Var CompanyName
Var ProductName

;DCOM98
Var DCOM98INSTALL ;Do we need to install DCOM98? Yes or No
Var DCOM98RETURN ;What is the return code for DCOM98? (not necessary in our case, but NSIS will error out if there is no variable to hold the rerurn code, ALWAYS reboot after install)

;Windows Script Host
Var SCRRUNVER ;Version of WSH to check against (5.6)
Var SCRRUNDLL ;Version of WSH installed on machine
Var scr_exit_code ;Exit code from WSH installer

;Version of $ProductName installed
Var TSTOREVER

;Source Code installation folder. Typically $INSTDIR\Source
Var SRCCODE

;Unistall Registry Key Location
Var UNINSREG

;For comparing previous installations of $ProductName
Var IS_INSTALLED ;Yes or No: is $ProductName installed?
Var TSTORESETUP ;Variable to hold product version data

;InstallSpider UI (https://nsis.sourceforge.io/InstallSpiderUI)
;Drop in replacement for MUI2 to mimic Wizard95 installer interface
!include "ISUI.nsh"

;For using Logic operators
!include "LogicLib.nsh"

;Detect Windows Version
!include "WinVer.nsh"

;For installing my system libraries
!include "Library.nsh"

;For getting file functions
!include "FileFunc.nsh"

;For comparing versions
!include "WordFunc.nsh"

;Installer for $CompanyName $ProductName
Name "$CompanyName $ProductName"
OutFile "tssetup100.exe"
BrandingText "$CompanyName"

;Show file copy operations
ShowInstDetails show
ShowUninstDetails show

;Default install folder
InstallDir "$PROGRAMFILES\$CompanyName\$ProductName"

;Install Folder Registry Key
InstallDirRegKey HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Installation Folder"

;Subscribe to Common Controls 6.0 in Windows XP+
XPStyle on

;Request application privileges for Windows Vista and above
;See un.onInit and .onInit for older versions of WinNT Admin Rights checks
;un/.onInit will also handle Admin checks if UAC is turned off
RequestExecutionLevel admin

;What versions of Windows UAC dialogs to support
ManifestSupportedOS all

;Version this installer has
!getdllversion "..\Build\TStore.exe" Expv_

;Installation Version Information
VIProductVersion "${Expv_1}.${Expv_2}.${Expv_3}.${Expv_4}"
VIAddVersionKey "ProductName" "$ProductName"
VIAddVersionKey "Comments" ""
VIAddVersionKey "CompanyName" "$CompanyName"
VIAddVersionKey "LegalTrademarks" "$ProductName is a trademark of $CompanyName"
VIAddVersionKey "LegalCopyright" "Copyright (C) 2018-2020 $CompanyName"
VIAddVersionKey "FileDescription" "Stores the locations of games and trainers"
VIAddVersionKey "FileVersion" "${Expv_1}.${Expv_2}.${Expv_3}.${Expv_4}"


;Install Pages
!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_WELCOME
	;Set up our License page
	!define MUI_LICENSEPAGE_RADIOBUTTONS
	!define MUI_LICENSEPAGE_RADIOBUTTONS_TEXT_ACCEPT "I &Accept"
	!define MUI_LICENSEPAGE_RADIOBUTTONS_TEXT_DECLINE "I &Decline"
!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_LICENSE "License\LICENSE.rtf"
!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_COMPONENTS
!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_DIRECTORY
!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_INSTFILES
	;Set up our Finish page
	!define MUI_FINISHPAGE_RUN $INSTDIR\TStore.exe
	!define MUI_FINISHPAGE_RUN_TEXT "&Launch $ProductName"
	!define MUI_FINISHPAGE_LINK "&Visit the $ProductName Website"
	!define MUI_FINISHPAGE_LINK_LOCATION "https://storetrainer.raggiesoft.com/"
!insertmacro MUI_PAGE_FINISH

;Uninstall Pages
!insertmacro MUI_UNPAGE_WELCOME
!insertmacro MUI_UNPAGE_CONFIRM
!insertmacro MUI_UNPAGE_INSTFILES
!insertmacro MUI_UNPAGE_FINISH

;Language Setting (yes, AFTER pages are loaded)
!insertmacro MUI_LANGUAGE "English"



;Microsoft Redistribution Files
;Only needed for older systems
;ABSOLUTELY POSITIVELY DO NOT ATTEMPT TO UNINSTALL!!!
Section "-Required System Components" SysComp
	;Most likely, these will only need to be installed on Windows 95/98
	;DO NOT ATTEMPT TO FORCIBLY REPLACE THESE FILES ON WINDOWS 2000 OR NEWER!!
	;For newer operating systems (2000, ME, and above), this will check with System File Protection before copying DLLs
	;This installer contains the 2012 re-release of the Visual Basic 6.0 DLLs
	
	;Start with the VB6 Runtime
	DetailPrint "Installing Microsoft Visual Basic 6.0 Runtime"
	!insertmacro InstallLib REGDLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\msvbvm60.dll" "$SYSDIR\msvbvm60.dll" "$SYSDIR"
	!insertmacro InstallLib REGDLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\oleaut32.dll" "$SYSDIR\oleaut32.dll" "$SYSDIR"
	!insertmacro InstallLib REGDLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\olepro32.dll" "$SYSDIR\olepro32.dll" "$SYSDIR"
	!insertmacro InstallLib REGDLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\comcat.dll" "$SYSDIR\comcat.dll" "$SYSDIR"
	!insertmacro InstallLib DLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\asycfilt.dll" "$SYSDIR\asycfilt.dll" "$SYSDIR"
	!insertmacro InstallLib TLB "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\stdole2.tlb"  "$SYSDIR\stdole2.tlb" "$SYSDIR"
	
	;Let's install the Windows Common Controls
	DetailPrint "Installing Windows Common Controls"
	!insertmacro InstallLib REGDLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\comct232.ocx" "$SYSDIR\comct232.ocx" "$SYSDIR"
	!insertmacro InstallLib REGDLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\comctl32.ocx" "$SYSDIR\comctl32.ocx" "$SYSDIR"
	
	;Let's install the Windows Common Dialog Control
	DetailPrint "Installing Windows Common Dialog Control"
	!insertmacro InstallLib REGDLL "${ALREADY_INSTALLED}" REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\comdlg32.ocx" "$SYSDIR\comdlg32.ocx" "$SYSDIR"
	
	;Windows Script Host ActiveX Control
	;In a moment, we will also install the Windows Script Host Runtime
	DetailPrint "Installing Windows Script Host ActiveX Control"
	!insertmacro InstallLib REGDLL ${ALREADY_INSTALLED} REBOOT_PROTECTED "Microsoft Redist\wshom.ocx" "$SYSDIR\wshom.ocx" "$SYSDIR"

	;Let's get DCOM and the Windows Script Host going.  Only required for Windows 2000 or older
	SetOutPath $TEMP
	File "Microsoft Redist\DCOM98\DCOM98.exe"
	File "Microsoft Redist\WSH56\WScr9x.exe"
	File "Microsoft Redist\WSH56\WScrNT2k.exe"
	
	;Let's check for, and if necessary, install DCOM98 on this computer.
	;It is only needed on Windows 95/98
	${IfNot} ${IsNT}
		;Yes or no: is DCOM98 installed
		;If we need to drill down deeper, this returns a version string (but I don't need to)
		;A reboot is mandatory according to the Microsoft documentation
		;We are going to run in Silent mode, with no DCOM98 reboot (while telling NSIS to reboot at the end of EVERYTHING)
		ReadRegStr $DCOM98INSTALL HKCR "CLSID\{bdc67890-4fc0-11d0-a805-00aa006d2ea4}" "InstalledVersion"
		${If} $DCOM98INSTALL == ""
			DetailPrint "Installing DCOM98..."
			ExecWait "$\"$TEMP\DCOM98.exe$\" $\"/r:n /q:u$\"" $DCOM98RETURN
			SetRebootFlag true
		${EndIf}
	${EndIf}
	;Let's install Windows Script Host (already included with XP+)
	;First, let's get the file version of scrrun.dll (Scripting Host).  We have installers for version 5.6 of the runtime
	${GetFileVersion} "$SYSDIR\scrrun.dll" $SCRRUNDLL
	${VersionCompare} "5.6" $SCRRUNDLL $SCRRUNVER
	${If} $SCRRUNVER == "1"
		${If} ${IsNT}
			${If} ${AtMostWin2000}
				;Windows Script Host for Windows NT 4.0 and Windows 2000
				DetailPrint "Installing Windows Script Host 5.6 for Windows NT 4.0 and Windows 2000"
				ExecWait "$\"$TEMP\WScrNT2k.exe$\" $\"/q /r:n$\"" $scr_exit_code
				SetRebootFlag true
			${EndIf}
		${Else}
			;Windows Script Host for Windows 95/98
			DetailPrint "Installing Windows Script Host 5.6 for Windows 95 and 98"
			ExecWait "$\"$TEMP\Wscr9x.exe$\" $\"/q /r:n$\"" $scr_exit_code
			SetRebootFlag true
		${EndIf}
	${EndIf}
	

	
	;Finished installing System Components
SectionEnd
;$ProductName Install
Section "$CompanyName $ProductName" TStoreBase
	;We want Shortcuts to be for All Users
	SetShellVarContext all
	
	;Install Files
	SetOutPath $INSTDIR
	SetOverwrite ifnewer
	DetailPrint "Installing $ProductName"
	File "..\Build\TStore.exe"
	File "..\Build\TStore.exe.manifest"
	File "..\README.txt"
	File "License\LICENSE.rtf"
	
	;Get the Product Version
	${GetFileVersion} "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe" $TSTOREVER
	
	;Create Shortcut
	CreateShortcut "$SMPROGRAMS\$ProductName.lnk" "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe" "" "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe" 0 "SW_SHOWNORMAL" "" "$ProductName stores the locations of your games and trainers in an easy to use format"
	
	;Create $ProductName Registry entries
	WriteRegStr HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Installation Folder" "$INSTDIR"
	WriteRegStr HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Product Version" "$TSTOREVER"
	WriteRegStr HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "SMFolder" "$SMPROGRAMS"
	WriteRegStr HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Uninstall Key Location" "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$CompanyName $ProductName"
	
	;Create master TSTORE.INI file (meant to be read-only)
	WriteINIStr "$INSTDIR\TStore.ini" "General" "Version" "$TSTOREVER"
	WriteINIStr "$INSTDIR\TStore.ini" "General" "Path" "$INSTDIR"
	
SectionEnd
Section "Source Code" Src
	;Install the Source Code
	DetailPrint "Installing Source Code"
	StrCpy $SRCCODE "$INSTDIR\Source"
	CreateDirectory "$SRCCODE"
	SetOutPath "$SRCCODE"
	
	;$ProductName Source Code
	File "..\DetectOSBits.bas"
	File "..\frmMain.frm"
	File "..\INIFile.bas"
	File "..\OSVersionInfo.bas"
	File "..\README.txt"
	File "..\Registry.bas"
	File "..\SFile.bas"
	File "..\SpecialFolder.bas"
	File "..\TStore.bas"
	File "..\TStore.PDM"
	File "..\TStore.vbp"
	File "..\TStore.vbw"
	File "..\VersionCompare.bas"
	File "..\wHwnd.bas"
	CreateDirectory "$SRCCODE\Installer"
	CreateDirectory "$SRCCODE\Build"
	SetOutPath "$SRCCODE\Installer"
	File "TSSetup.nsi"
	File "TSSetup-Patch.nsi"
	
	;Let's recreate the Microsoft Redist folders that TSSetup.nsi expects
	CreateDirectory "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist"
	SetOutPath "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist"
	
	;Copy the existing files so that they are in the locations TSSetup.nsi expects
	;The numbers at the end are the size in KB so the insaller can correctly do disk costing
	;NOTE: The Visual Basic 6.0 runtime files are from the 2012 Security Update
	;The InstallLib macro above correctly handles file updates, even on modern versions of Windows
	;DO NOT ATTEMPT TO REGISTER THESE COPIES OF SYSTEM FILES - YOU WILL BREAK WINDOWS
	CopyFiles "$SYSDIR\asycfilt.dll" "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist" 145
	CopyFiles "$SYSDIR\comcat.dll" "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist" 22
	CopyFiles "$SYSDIR\comct232.ocx" "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist" 167
	CopyFiles "$SYSDIR\comctl32.ocx" "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist" 604
	CopyFiles "$SYSDIR\comdlg32.ocx" "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist" 153
	CopyFiles "$SYSDIR\msvbvm60.dll" "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist" 1354
	CopyFiles "$SYSDIR\oleaut32.dll" "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist" 585
	CopyFiles "$SYSDIR\olepro32.dll" "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist" 161
	CopyFiles "$SYSDIR\stdole2.tlb" "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist" 18
	CopyFiles "$SYSDIR\wshom.ocx" "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist" 101
	
	CreateDirectory "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist\DCOM98"
	SetOutPath "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist\DCOM98"
	CopyFiles "$TEMP\DCOM98.exe" "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist\DCOM98" 1194
	
	CreateDirectory "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist\WSH56"
	SetOutPath "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist\WSH56"
	CopyFiles "$TEMP\WScr9x.exe" "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist\WSH56" 716
	CopyFiles "$TEMP\WScrNT2k.exe" "$SRCCODE\Installer\Microsoft Redist\WSH56" 716
SectionEnd
Section "-Unistall Registry Keys" Unins
	;Create Uninstall Registry Entries
	DetailPrint "Creating Uninstaller"
	StrCpy $UNINSREG "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$CompanyName $ProductName"
	
	;Get $ProductName file version for the Uninstall Registry key
	${GetFileVersion} "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe" $R0
	
	;Write the keys to the Registry
	WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "DisplayName" "$CompanyName $ProductName"
	WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "DisplayVersion" $R0
	WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "UninstallString" "$INSTDIR\uninstall.exe"
	WriteRegStr HKLM $UNINSREG "Publisher" "$CompanyName"
	
	;Write our Uninstaller
	WriteUninstaller "$INSTDIR\uninstall.exe"
SectionEnd
Section "-Cleanup" Cleanup
	;Let's remove the redist installers
	DetailPrint "Cleaning up"
	Delete "$TEMP\DCOM98.exe"
	Delete "$TEMP\Wscr9x.exe"
	Delete "$TEMP\WScrNT2k.exe"
SectionEnd

;Section Descriptions
LangString DESC_TStoreBase ${LANG_ENGLISH} "$ProductName stores the locations of games and trainers"
LangString DESC_Src ${LANG_ENGLISH} "Source Code for $ProductName (Visual Basic 6)"
!insertmacro MUI_FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION_BEGIN
	!insertmacro MUI_DESCRIPTION_TEXT ${TStoreBase} $(DESC_TStoreBase)
	!insertmacro MUI_DESCRIPTION_TEXT ${Src} $(DESC_Src)
!insertmacro MUI_FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION_END

;This runs when the program is uninstalling
Section "Uninstall"
	;We want Shortcuts to be for All Users
	SetShellVarContext all
	
	;Grab the proper installation folder (in case the uninstaller is in the wrong place)
	ReadRegStr $INSTDIR HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Installation Folder"
	
	;Remove our Registry keys
	DetailPrint "Deleting Registry Keys"
	DeleteRegKey HKLM "Software\Microsoft Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$CompanyName $ProductName"
	DeleteRegKey HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName"
	DeleteRegKey /ifempty HKLM "Software\$CompanyName"
	
	;Remove $ProductName's executable
	DetailPrint "Uninstalling $ProductName"
	RMDir /r /REBOOTOK "$INSTDIR\Source" ;Recursively search the folder to clear out any extra files
	Delete "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe"
	Delete "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe.manifest"
	Delete "$INSTDIR\License.rtf"
	Delete "$INSTDIR\README.txt"
	Delete "$INSTDIR\TStore.ini"
	Delete "$INSTDIR\uninstall.exe"
	RMDir "$INSTDIR" ;DO NOT do a /r recursive search (in case, for example, someone installed to C:\Program Files this would really mess up the users computer)
	RMDir $PROGRAMFILES\$CompanyName ;AGAIN, do NOT use /r (this deletes it ONLY IF EMPTY)
	
	DetailPrint "Deleting Shortcuts"
	Delete "$SMPROGRAMS\$ProductName.lnk"
	
	;We are DONE with uninstall
	;As a reminder, DO NOT TOUCH any of the Microsoft DLLs that get installed
	;Also, $ProductName's per-user files do not get uninstalled (it's just not possible to remove files for users other than your own in the main uninstaller, however it is possible to release a utility that does PER-USER cleaning)
	
SectionEnd

;We need to do some checks when the installer and uninstaller are started.

;Tests for Admin rights NT4/2000/XP
;Also works if somehow UAC is disabled or broken on Vista+
;Also, on Windows NT 4.0, the Visual Basic runtime requires Service Pack 3 or later installed
Function .onInit
	;Company and Product
	StrCpy $CompanyName "RaggieSoft"
	StrCpy $ProductName "StoreTrainer"
	
	;Redefine the install folder
	StrCpy $INSTDIR "$PROGRAMFILES\$CompanyName\$ProductName"
	
	;Check for NT Admin Rights
	UserInfo::GetAccountType
	pop $0
	${If} $0 != "admin" ;Require admin rights on NT4+
		MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP|MB_OK "Administrator rights required to install $ProductName!" /SD IDOK
		SetErrorLevel 740 ;ERROR_ELEVATION_REQUIRED
		Quit
	${EndIf}

	;Check for NT 4.0 SP3 or higher
	;Otherwise, $ProductName *SHOULD* be able to run on any other 32bit or 64bit OS
	;That is Windows 95 or later.  Sorry Windows 3.1
	${If} ${IsNT}
		${If} ${IsWinNT4}
			${If} ${AtMostServicePack} 2
				MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP|MB_OK "Service Pack 3 or higher is required for Windows NT 4.0" /SD IDOK
				SetErrorLevel 3 ;3 because Service Pack 3 (pun intended)
				Quit
			${EndIf}
		${EndIf}
	${EndIf}
	
	;Detect previous version
	ReadRegStr  $IS_INSTALLED HKLM "Software\$CompanyName\$ProductName" "Installation Folder"
	IfFileExists "$IS_INSTALLED\uninstall.exe" FileFound EndFileExistsTest
	FileFound:
		;Let's check file versions.
		${GetFileVersion} "$INSTDIR\TStore.exe" $R0
		${GetFileVersion} "$EXEPATH" $R1
		${VersionCompare} $R0 $R1 $TSTORESETUP
		
		;This installer is the same as what is already installed
		${If} $TSTORESETUP == 0
			Exec "$IS_INSTALLED\uninstall.exe"
			SetErrorLevel 4
			Quit
		${EndIf}
		
		;This installer has an older version of $ProductName
		${If} $TSSETUP == 1
			MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP|MB_OK "This installer contains an older version of $ProductName.$\r$\nSetup will now close." /SD IDOK
			SetErrorLevel 5
			Quit
		${EndIf}
	EndFileExistsTest:

		
FunctionEnd
Function un.onInit
	;Company and Product
	StrCpy $CompanyName "RaggieSoft"
	StrCpy $ProductName "StoreTrainer"
	
	UserInfo::GetAccountType
	pop $0
	${If} $0 != "admin" ;Require admin rights on NT4+
		MessageBox MB_ICONSTOP|MB_OK "Administrator rights required to uninstall $ProductName!" /SD IDOK
		SetErrorLevel 740 ;ERROR_ELEVATION_REQUIRED
		Quit
	${EndIf}
FunctionEnd
